title: Verify a user can log in with valid credentials
preconditions: The application is running and student@example.com with the configured password exists
steps: Send POST /api/v1/auth/login with email student@example.com and its valid password
expected_result: The response includes a populated access_token, token_type bearer, and a user object whose email is student@example.com.

title: Verify a user cannot log in with an invalid password
preconditions: The application is running and student@example.com exists
steps: Send POST /api/v1/auth/login with email student@example.com and password wrongpassword
expected_result: The response status is 401 and the error has code INVALID_CREDENTIALS and message Invalid email or password.
